title: Close the day with a reread, open it with a recall
summary: End one short read before sleep and start the next day by recalling it without looking.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: The last minutes of a day are a good place for a short read, and the first minutes of the next are a good place for a test. Reread one small passage or word list at night, then in the morning say what you can remember before you look, because retrieval from memory, not the rereading itself, is what strengthens the trace. Keep the morning attempt to ninety seconds and accept partial recall as the normal result. Write down only the words that came back, so your growing list reflects what you actually own.
